==Description== 
'''Frozen''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Frost Invasion Event#Frost Invasion Season Pass|Frost Invasion Season]]. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote.  

This emote was obtainable at Rank 3 of the Event Season Pass, which would cost {{Shards|300 Shards}} or {{Robux|125}} at that rank. The total cost was {{Shards|675 Shards}} or {{Robux|250}}.

==Trivia==
*The ice block's width, height and length depends on the player's avatar scaling.
*Generally, the usage of the emote will cause the player to ragdoll.
*This emote increases your hitbox with objects, this allows you to clip through walls and tight spaces.
**You can take advantage of this, as it can let you move into places that you are not normally allowed to go.
**This may cause rapid movement of the player's character between two locations. 
*This emote allows the player to float on water.
*This [[Emotes|emote]], along with the [[Lazy Couch]], [[Firework]], [[Raw Dinner]], [[Recliner]] and [[Axe Throw]] emotes, are the only emotes to play global sounds.
*The ice block appears larger on the screen of the player who used the emote than to everybody else.
*If this emote is activated while sprinting and then deactivated while not sprinting, you will still be sprinting despite not holding the sprint button.
**On desktop, it is possible to simply set your sprint button to W, so that you always sprint while walking.
